questions.questionText: A ball is dropped from a height of 20m. Find the time taken to reach the ground (g = 10 m/s^2).
Calculate 15% of 240 without using a calculator.
State Newton's third law of motion.
questions.studentAnswer: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction — when object A exerts a force on object B, object B exerts an equal and opposite force back on object A.
